findings.source_quote: “The child takes on the characteristic behavior of the group in which he is placed … he reflects the behavior patterns which are set by the … leader of the group” (Kurt Lewin, in A Sociology of Education).
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the English common noun 'leader' into French to avoid leaving a substantive word in English. Keep the quote structure and punctuation. For example: « L’enfant prend le comportement caractéristique du groupe dans lequel il est placé … il reflète les schémas de comportement qui sont établis par le … dirigeant du groupe » (Kurt Lewin, in A Sociology of Education).
